data.one_liner: An animated bottom navigation bar with a sliding indicator and custom badges
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable bottom navigation bar where the active tab icon animates into place with a sliding motion effect. It supports custom icons or widgets, notification badges, and programmatic tab control via a custom controller.
use_when: You want an animated bottom navigation bar with a floating active tab indicator
You need to display notification badges or indicators on specific tabs
You need programmatic control to change the active tab index
avoid_when: You need standard Material NavigationBar or BottomNavigationBar components
You require built-in swipe navigation handling within the TabBarView (swipe navigation handling is not supported)
strengths: Smooth motion animations for the active tab indicator
Supports both standard IconData and custom icon widgets
weaknesses: Swipe navigation handling is not supported by default
Relies on a custom controller setup for programmatic changes
